Review status: draft

The rear-leg sequence is improved, but QA found abrupt foot changes at 4→5, 8→9, 12→13 and 16→1. These contacts and the loop seam need refinement before this artwork goes into the game.

What to judge
  • Does she still look like Ronnie—especially her face, ears, black saddle and freckled paws?
  • Does this calmer walking direction feel right?
  • Is her body steady enough at the small display size?

Both sides use the same 1.28-second cycle at 1×, isolating the artwork comparison. This is in-place playback; paw traction during travel still needs checking when integrated. New artwork has not replaced the live game.
